---
title: "Mistral Cookbook preview"
---

This Quarto site provides a local preview for cookbook content in this repository. It is meant for authoring and review, not as a replacement for the cookbook pages on `docs.mistral.ai`.

## Preview locally

Install Quarto, generate the local preview files, then run the preview:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_quarto_index.py
quarto preview --profile preview
```

To render a static site, run:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_quarto_index.py
quarto render --profile preview
```

The generated site is written to `site/`. Sanitized Markdown preview files are written as ignored sibling `.qmd` files next to their source Markdown files.

## What this preview includes

- Jupyter notebooks (`.ipynb`) from `mistral/`, `third_party/`, `concept-deep-dive/`, and the root quickstart.
- Markdown guides (`.md`) from the same cookbook areas, rendered through sanitized generated preview copies.
- A generated cookbook index grouped by section from `README.md`.

Notebook code is not executed during preview. Quarto renders the committed notebook content and outputs as they exist in the repository.

## Cookbook index

Open [Cookbooks](/cookbooks.html) to browse the generated list.
